hunks.baseline: Had I been unable to guess from the start, or had I been trying so hard to deny it because reality was that hard to believe?
hunks.sol: Had I failed to guess it from the start? Or had I tried to deny it because the truth was so hard to believe?

hunks.baseline: This time, at least, I could answer that question for myself.
hunks.sol: This time, I could answer that question myself.

hunks.baseline: *I think it was the latter.*
hunks.sol: I think it was the latter.

hunks.baseline: The realization struck my mind, now as white as a blank page.
hunks.sol: The realization struck my mind, leaving it blank as a sheet of paper.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, I felt the last shred of faith I’d held in my heart crumble, along with everything I’d thought I knew about this world.
hunks.sol: At the same time, I felt the last shred of faith I’d held on to crumble, along with everything I’d thought I knew about this world.

hunks.baseline: The strange Moving Formation, whose existence had already been revealed long ago in Henan and Sichuan.
hunks.sol: The strange Moving Formation, which had first appeared in Henan and Sichuan.

hunks.baseline: The Water God Dragon and countless Blood Fish, corrupted by something in Hubei and sent into a rampage.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon and countless Blood Fish, corrupted by something in Hubei and driven into a frenzy.

hunks.baseline: An utterly ordinary fisherman who’d eaten those Blood Fish and gained monstrous strength and an equally monstrous appearance.
hunks.sol: An utterly ordinary fisherman who’d eaten those Blood Fish and gained a monster’s appearance and strength.

hunks.baseline: The cause of all those phenomena—and not just that, but the rift that had appeared once more in the jungles of Nanman.
hunks.sol: The rift that had caused all of it—and then appeared again in the jungles of Nanman.

hunks.baseline: And the familiar beings called Black Ghosts, whom I’d come face-to-face with right here today.
hunks.sol: Even the familiar beings called Black Ghosts, whom I’d faced right here today.

hunks.baseline: At last, everything came into focus.
hunks.sol: At last, it was unmistakable.

hunks.baseline: In this very moment, it was laid out before my eyes for all to see. It pierced my ears and flowed clearly through my senses.
hunks.sol: It was unfolding right before my eyes. I could hear it, feel it flowing clearly through my senses.

hunks.baseline: All those portents, signs, and omens that had come before.
hunks.sol: All the warnings that had come before—call them signs, omens, whatever you wanted.

hunks.baseline: Whatever you wanted to call them, all of them had finally burst through a colossal dam and swept over me.
Turning the suspicion I’d only toyed with in my heart into certainty.
hunks.sol: They had finally broken through a great dam and come crashing down on me, turning the suspicion I’d only entertained in private into certainty.

hunks.baseline: With one word:
The wind blew. A shadow with speed and power far beyond human limits glided toward me, leaving a long afterimage.
hunks.sol: The wind blew. A shadow moving with speed and power far beyond human limits glided toward me, trailing a long afterimage.

hunks.baseline: But I couldn’t even twitch a finger.
hunks.sol: But I couldn’t move a finger.

hunks.baseline: In a world gone slow, with my whole body feeling as if the blood in it had turned cold, all I could do was stare, dumbfounded.
hunks.sol: The world had slowed. My blood felt cold, and all I could do was stare.

hunks.baseline: *What is this…?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is this…?*

hunks.baseline: Where a massive bomb had exploded, nothing remained but ruins and the shock wave.
hunks.sol: When a massive bomb goes off, all it leaves behind is wreckage and a shock wave.

hunks.baseline: And in my mind, now little better than those ruins, words and question marks scattered in every direction in the wake of the blast.
hunks.sol: My mind was wreckage now. Words and questions scattered through it, caught in the blast.

hunks.baseline: Magic, mage, monster, Blood-Sword Demon Lord, buff.
hunks.sol: Magic. Mage. Monster. Blood-Sword Demon Lord. Buff.

hunks.baseline: A large-scale attack spell and the sacrifice of our allies. Countless deaths and blood overflowing in every direction. Mangled corpses floating among it all.
hunks.sol: A large-scale attack spell. Allies sacrificed. Countless deaths, blood spilling everywhere, broken bodies floating in it.

hunks.baseline: How could this be possible?
hunks.sol: How was any of this possible?

hunks.baseline: Everything scattered through my mind. I was left alone with a question I couldn’t answer.
hunks.sol: Every thought scattered. Only that question remained, and I had no answer.

hunks.baseline: Then—
A hard, rough hand—familiar, too—landed on my shoulder.
hunks.sol: A hard, rough hand—one I knew—closed around my shoulder.

hunks.baseline: No. The instant I felt it, a powerful force had already dragged me backward, sending me stumbling without strength.
hunks.sol: No. By the time I felt it, its powerful grip was already hauling me backward, and I gave way without resistance.

hunks.baseline: Only then did I realize that time had begun flowing again—and that a streak of light had been swung like lightning through the gap.
hunks.sol: Only then did time begin to move again. A streak of light tore through the gap like lightning.

hunks.baseline: A roar like the sky splitting apart, and my senses returned.
hunks.sol: A roar like the sky splitting apart brought my senses rushing back.

hunks.baseline: Somewhere in the air behind me, I was already soaring, caught up in a weightless sensation. The enormous shock wave hit me along with it.
hunks.sol: I was already airborne somewhere behind where I’d stood. As I hung weightless, an enormous shock wave struck.

hunks.baseline: The earth flipped as if in an earthquake. Two immense forces melted and crushed everything around them.
hunks.sol: The ground heaved like an earthquake had hit. Two immense forces melted and shattered everything around them.

hunks.baseline: At the center of that tremendous clash, which had swallowed an area dozens of *jang* across, Jeok Cheongang had shoved me aside when I froze like a statue and stepped in to stop the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: At the center of the clash, which swallowed dozens of *jang* in every direction, stood Jeok Cheongang. He had shoved me aside when I froze like a statue and stepped in to stop the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: “Gah!”
hunks.sol: “Hah!”

hunks.baseline: How had I flown so far?
hunks.sol: How had I flown so far already?

hunks.baseline: Even so, I could tell that Jeok Cheongang’s shout, backed by his profound internal energy, wasn’t just a battle cry.
hunks.sol: Even at this distance, I could tell Jeok Cheongang’s shout, charged with profound internal energy, was more than a battle cry.

hunks.baseline: *He’s shouting at me. Trying to bring me back to my senses.*
hunks.sol: *That was for me. He’s trying to wake me up.*

hunks.baseline: The shout reached my ears and jolted my half-dazed mind awake. Only then could I let out the breath I’d been holding.
hunks.sol: It reached my ears and jolted my half-dazed mind awake. At last, I let out the breath I’d been holding.

hunks.baseline: I still couldn’t understand how something like this could happen in the real world, but what did that matter when death was right in front of me?
hunks.sol: I still couldn’t understand how any of this could be happening. But with death right in front of me, what did understanding matter?

hunks.baseline: There was no use in understanding when the water had already spilled.
hunks.sol: The water was spilled. There was no use dwelling on how.

hunks.baseline: Here on this battlefield, all I could do was accept reality and find a way through it.
hunks.sol: All I could do on this battlefield was accept what was happening and find a way through it.

hunks.baseline: And that was how I’d save everyone.
hunks.sol: That was how I’d save everyone.

hunks.baseline: Slip.
hunks.sol: Srrk.

hunks.baseline: Still feeling weightless, I smoothly twisted my body.
hunks.sol: Still suspended in the air, I twisted smoothly around.

hunks.baseline: The muscles and internal energy I’d fully recovered after that last Level Up carried out the order from my mind with perfect speed and precision.
hunks.sol: My muscles and internal energy, fully restored by that last Level Up, obeyed the command in my mind without the slightest delay or error.

hunks.baseline: I stepped on the air with a qi-charged foot and shot forward like an explosion, toward Jeok Cheongang, clashing with the Blood-Sword Demon Lord twenty *jang* away.
hunks.sol: I kicked off the air with a foot charged with qi and shot toward Jeok Cheongang, who was clashing with the Blood-Sword Demon Lord more than twenty *jang* away.

hunks.baseline: No—that was what I meant to do.
hunks.sol: Or I tried to.

hunks.baseline: Until a tremendous invisible force came crashing down on me as I cut through the wind.
hunks.sol: As I cut through the wind, an immense, invisible force descended on me.

hunks.baseline: And as soon as I realized it, I heard a voice ringing faintly from far away.
hunks.sol: The instant I noticed, I heard a faint voice from far away.

hunks.baseline: My eyes widened as I recognized the meaning behind that quiet voice. But there was nothing I could do to stop it, coming from a hill fifty *jang* away, beneath the pure-white veil of a woman dressed in white.
hunks.sol: I knew what that quiet invocation meant. My eyes widened, but I couldn’t stop the clear voice issuing from beneath a pure-white veil on a hill fifty *jang* away.

hunks.baseline: A weight as immense as Taishan pressed down on my whole body.
hunks.sol: A weight as immense as Taishan bore down on my whole body.

hunks.baseline: No—it made me fall.
hunks.sol: No—it sent me plummeting.

hunks.baseline: Down through the ranks of countless enemies, who’d gathered like clouds during the brief moment I’d been airborne and aimed their spears and bows at me.
hunks.sol: Straight toward the countless enemies who had gathered like clouds during the brief moment I’d been airborne, their spears and bows aimed at me.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed the cry of shock that was about to slip through my lips.
hunks.sol: I swallowed my cry of shock.

hunks.baseline: And instead of resisting this unexpected spell, I let it take hold and turned it into a weapon.
hunks.sol: Instead of resisting this second, unexpected spell, I let it take hold and turned it into a weapon.

hunks.baseline: I came crashing down with the weight of ten thousand *geun*. The ground split, and the enemies around me staggered, losing their balance. At the same time, I felt the crushing pressure around me naturally disperse.
hunks.sol: I struck the ground under the weight of ten thousand *geun*. The earth split, and the enemies around me staggered off balance. At the same time, I felt the pressure pinning me down dissipate.

hunks.baseline: *Of course it did.*
hunks.sol: *Of course.*

hunks.baseline: Gravity acted on a space, not on a specific person.
hunks.sol: Gravity acted on an area, not a single person.

hunks.baseline: I’d been the first to feel its effects while I was airborne, but once I landed, that changed.
hunks.sol: While I was airborne, I’d been the first to feel the spell’s effects. Once I landed, that was no longer true.

hunks.baseline: The white-robed figures were clearly mages. If they wanted to bind me even a little, their gravity magic would have to target the Dark Heaven followers who were their allies, too.
hunks.sol: Those white-robed figures were clearly mages. To keep me pinned down now, they’d have to catch their own allies—the followers of Dark Heaven—in the spell as well.

hunks.baseline: So they were trying to delay me from joining Jeok Cheongang, even if only for a moment…
hunks.sol: So even if they couldn’t stop me, they meant to delay me from joining Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: The enemies staggered like lifeless wooden puppets. I turned in place and swept the White Flame in my hand across them.
hunks.sol: The followers staggered like soulless wooden puppets. I turned in place and swept White Flame across them.

hunks.baseline: The sound of the spear cutting through the air was more than fierce—it was destructive.
hunks.sol: The spear’s passage through the air sounded less fierce than outright destructive.

hunks.baseline: A horizontal strike was a simple attack anyone could perform. But none of the enemies surrounding me could stop the wave of Force bursting from White Flame’s translucent spearhead.
hunks.sol: Anyone could swing a spear sideways. But none of the enemies surrounding me could stop the wave of Force that burst from White Flame’s translucent spearhead.

hunks.baseline: Not one of them.
hunks.sol: Not one.

hunks.baseline: Everything was cut apart and crushed.
hunks.sol: Everything was cut apart or crushed.

hunks.baseline: Weapons and people alike.
hunks.sol: Weapons. People.

hunks.baseline: In the blink of an eye, the ground within a three-*jang* radius had become a field of death. Yet the fear had been stripped from them. They stared at me with dark, unseeing eyes and kept charging.
hunks.sol: Within a blink, a three-*jang* radius had become a field of death. Yet the followers, stripped of fear, stared straight at me with their dark eyes and kept coming.

hunks.baseline: As if bewitched, they murmured the eight words of their creed.
hunks.sol: They murmured the eight words of their creed as if entranced.

hunks.baseline: A body without a head toppled over. The spearhead swung again, flashing sideways through three enemies approaching from the side.
hunks.sol: A headless body toppled. My spear flashed sideways through three more enemies closing in from the flank.

hunks.baseline: Neither a weapon imbued with Sword Energy nor a body trained in the external arts was enough against overwhelming force.
hunks.sol: Weapons imbued with Sword Energy and bodies hardened by the external arts alike were helpless against overwhelming force.

hunks.baseline: I pressed forward without hesitation, piercing through the fragments of steel and flesh that scattered around me.
hunks.sol: I drove through the scattering fragments of steel and flesh without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: I streaked like lightning between the enemies blocking my way like a wall, thinking and commanding without pause.
hunks.sol: As I streaked between the enemies blocking my path like a wall, I kept issuing commands in my head.

hunks.baseline: I cut, stabbed, and crushed without holding back.
hunks.sol: I cut, stabbed, and crushed my way forward.

hunks.baseline: The weapons that had rested briefly in my hands disappeared after devouring one, or two or three, lives. And countless blades still lay hidden in the vast subspace, too immense to measure.
hunks.sol: Weapons stayed in my hands only briefly. Each took one life, or two or three, before it left me. Countless more blades still lay hidden in that vast subspace whose limits I couldn’t begin to guess.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, the thought crossed my mind that perhaps I could make some ridiculous idea real.
hunks.sol: Enough that a ridiculous thought suddenly occurred to me.

hunks.baseline: But why?
hunks.sol: So why did I feel otherwise?

hunks.baseline: I knocked away the weapons slashing at me from every direction.
hunks.sol: I knocked aside the weapons coming at me from every direction.

hunks.baseline: I crushed an enemy’s head with one punch as he approached from my blind spot.
hunks.sol: I crushed the head of an enemy approaching from my blind spot with a single punch.

hunks.baseline: The more I cut down the enemies in front of me, the stronger this inexplicable certainty grew.
hunks.sol: And the more enemies I cut down, the stronger that inexplicable certainty grew.

hunks.baseline: *Could this really be nothing more than a fantasy?*
hunks.sol: *Is it really just something I’m imagining?*

hunks.baseline: Blood scattered along the arc of my spear as I turned and swung it.
hunks.sol: I turned and swung my spear, leaving a mist of blood along its path.

hunks.baseline: I took a quick breath as I watched the enemies surge in from every direction to fill the gap left by the dead.
hunks.sol: As enemies surged in from every direction to fill the gap left by the dead, I took a short breath.

hunks.baseline: *I don’t know until I try it myself.*
hunks.sol: *I won’t know until I try.*

hunks.baseline: Now that I thought about it, it had always been that way.
hunks.sol: Thinking back, it had always been like this.

hunks.baseline: Every time I needed to break through a wall, I had to go beyond it. I had to make the impossible possible, turn imagination into reality.
hunks.sol: Every time I faced a wall, I’d had to do more than I thought I could. Make the impossible possible. Turn imagination into reality.

hunks.baseline: The time it took to exhale once. That was all I needed.
hunks.sol: One breath. That was all the time I needed.

hunks.baseline: Leaving behind the countless enemies who blocked my way, endlessly filling every empty space no matter how many I killed, I quietly closed my eyes and pictured the mountain of gleaming, razor-sharp steel somewhere inside the void called the Inventory.
hunks.sol: With countless enemies still blocking my path, filling every space no matter how many I killed, I quietly closed my eyes. I pictured the mountain of sharp, gleaming steel somewhere in the void called the Inventory.

hunks.baseline: Then, at last, I gave the command.
hunks.sol: Then I gave the command.

hunks.baseline: It was certainly insane. Something that could only exist as an idea.
hunks.sol: It was madness. The sort of thing that could exist only in my imagination.

hunks.baseline: But even in response to that absurd, desperate call, the System answered.
hunks.sol: But the System answered that absurd, desperate call.

hunks.baseline: In its own familiar way.
hunks.sol: The way it always did.

hunks.baseline: The chimes piled on top of one another. Their faint ripples became a wave, and the wave swallowed the space around me.
hunks.sol: Chimes layered over one another. Their faint ripples grew into a wave that swallowed the space around me.

hunks.baseline: My ears grew muffled. This was the first step toward making imagination real.
hunks.sol: My ears rang. Imagination had taken its first step into reality.

hunks.baseline: I opened my eyes to a chime so vast and majestic I’d never heard anything like it.
hunks.sol: I opened my eyes to a chime vaster and more majestic than any I’d ever heard.

hunks.baseline: And saw.
hunks.sol: And saw it.

hunks.baseline: Something looming over my head, forcing its way through a gap in unseen space and casting darkness below.
hunks.sol: Something had forced its way through a gap in unseen space above my head, casting a shadow below.

hunks.baseline: I also heard.
hunks.sol: I heard it, too.

hunks.baseline: The cold ring of hundreds of pieces of steel sliding against one another.
hunks.sol: The cold sound of hundreds of pieces of steel sliding against one another.

hunks.baseline: The possibilities within me, the limits I’d been given, were far higher and more distant than I’d imagined.
hunks.sol: What I was capable of, the limits I had been given, stretched far beyond anything I’d imagined.

hunks.baseline: I had the power to turn that ridiculous idea I’d just pictured into reality—at least in part.
hunks.sol: I had the power to make at least part of that ridiculous idea real.

hunks.baseline: In the slowed world, an immense force surged up from deep within me.
hunks.sol: In the slowed world, immense qi surged from deep within me.

hunks.baseline: The fire dragon coiled in my lower dantian flowed into every limb and bone. My blood surged faster, following the pounding of my heart.
hunks.sol: The fire dragon coiled in my lower dantian flowed through every limb and bone. Blood rushed with the pounding of my heart.

hunks.baseline: A fierce tremor. My heart pounded sharply.
hunks.sol: A fierce tremor. A racing pulse.

hunks.baseline: Right. That beat wasn’t coming from my heart alone.
hunks.sol: The beat wasn’t coming from my heart alone.

hunks.baseline: What the people called martial artists had newly named the Middle Dantian.
hunks.sol: What martial artists had come to call the Middle Dantian.

hunks.baseline: At this very moment, all my senses and nerves were focused there.
hunks.sol: Every nerve, every sense I possessed was fixed there.

hunks.baseline: Past the lower dantian, where lava rolled in waves, up to that lofty peak that reached toward the heavens.
hunks.sol: Past the lower dantian, where lava surged in waves, to that lofty peak rising toward the heavens.

hunks.baseline: Into a realm of Will that couldn’t be measured by strength or speed.
hunks.sol: To a realm of Will that strength and speed could not measure.

hunks.baseline: My vision blurred. A sharp pain stabbed through my head, as if someone were driving a needle into it.
hunks.sol: My vision blurred. Agony stabbed through my head as though someone were driving a needle into it.

hunks.baseline: But as if possessed, I spread both arms.
hunks.sol: But I spread my arms as if entranced.

hunks.baseline: In the flash that filled my vision, I felt a thrill greater than the pain. My hands were empty, holding nothing—but beyond the realm of touch, I traced and grasped each and every thing.
hunks.sol: A flash filled my sight, and I felt a thrill greater than the pain. My hands were empty, yet somewhere beyond the reach of touch, I felt and grasped each thing, one by one.

hunks.baseline: In that time that had felt like eternity, yet lasted no more than an instant.
hunks.sol: An eternity had passed. No more than an instant had passed.

hunks.baseline: Beneath a mountain of sabers and a forest of swords—a hundred blades aimed at countless enemies as if held by an invisible hand.
hunks.sol: Above me hung a mountain of sabers and a forest of swords: one hundred blades aimed at the countless enemies as though held by invisible hands.

hunks.baseline: And then, I parted my tightly closed lips.
hunks.sol: I parted my tightly closed lips.
